_comment: X accounts the Demand Radar watches (radar_x.py), organized in lanes. Radar batches them into from:-OR searches with a min_faves floor, so we only pay for tweets that are ALREADY viral - adding accounts is nearly free. Edit freely, no code change needed. OWNER DOCTRINE (Aug 1, permanent): the radar's job is (1) the most viral things happening in tech/AI/space and (2) the accounts that SUMMARIZE everything - not a CEO roll call. Keep the founders lane to the handful whose own tweets go viral; put the weight on summarizers and viral lanes.
